phases.description: Optional small UI/UX maintenance window before committing to v2.0.0 work. Scope is strictly bounded: replay keybind colocation, replay/crop timer state weirdness. Do NOT chase deeper MediaRecorder root causes here — those are deferred to v2.0.0. May be skipped entirely if v2.0.0 work is starting immediately.
phases.label: PHASE 0
phases.name: v1.1.1 Optional Maintenance
phases.summary: Small, optional v1.1.1 UI/keybind cleanup before v2 work

phases.description: Establish the v2.0.0 architecture boundary. Move away from Electron MediaRecorder replay buffering toward a native or native-like replay engine. Output of this phase: a chosen approach (native binary, helper process, NAPI addon, or sidecar) and a clear contract between Electron UI and the replay engine. No implementation here.
phases.label: PHASE 1
phases.name: v2.0.0 Architecture Research and Boundary
phases.summary: Pick the native/helper replay engine direction and lock the UI-to-engine contract

phases.description: Design the four core v2 subsystems: PipeWire capture backend, encoder backend matrix with fallback policy, rolling replay segment buffer, and instant replay export/remux pipeline. Each ticket produces a design doc with inputs, outputs, error handling, and integration points. No implementation.
phases.label: PHASE 2
phases.name: v2.0.0 Component Design
phases.summary: Design PipeWire capture, encoder matrix, rolling segments, and export pipeline

phases.description: Plan how the Electron UI integrates with the new native/helper replay engine, and define the validation matrix for 1080p60, 1440p60, and 4K60 across NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel encoder paths. Output: integration contract doc and a test plan that proves the v2 architecture exceeds the v1.1.0 ceiling.
phases.label: PHASE 3
phases.name: v2.0.0 Integration and Validation Planning
phases.summary: Plan UI<->engine integration and the full 1080p/1440p/4K60 validation matrix

phases.description: Final v2.0.0 release checklist: build verification across Linux and Windows, encoder fallback smoke tests, replay save validation at every target resolution, RELEASES.md update, sha256 sidecars per global rule, tag, and publish.
phases.label: PHASE 4
phases.name: v2.0.0 Release
phases.summary: v2.0.0 release checklist, validation, packaging, and publish
